payload.summary: No gate detects a test fixture that lies about its type: casts defeat tsc and vitest runs none
payload.detail: A cast on a fixture suppresses the only check that would catch a missing or phantom field, because vitest runs no typecheck and a cast silences tsc. Search by TARGET type, not by operator: 'as unknown as' appears 228 times in tests/ and almost all are legitimate (you cannot hand-construct a Request or an IntersectionObserver). Dangerous only when the target is a domain-model type. Filter comment lines: 'as' appearing is not 'as' being used. A 90-file sweep of ward tests never mentioned casts once - grep for cast across that document returns zero.
payload.source: Ward Builder Three, class handed over by Ward Builder One, measured at adcd8bcb5
